## NPN
- Connect the Emitter to ground
- Connect the load between $V_\mathrm{CC}$ and the Collector
- Control signal is connected to the Base through a resistor
**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
## PNP
- Connect the Emitter to $V_\mathrm{CC}$
- Connect the load between the Collector and ground
- Control signal is connected to the Base through a resistor
**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
